meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Turn the screen, Hale, I want to read the page myself. Then tell me whether anyone asked Owen about it before the zero went in.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

I'm writing that down, and I'll search it myself tonight. A line that "is not in Hamlet" tells me a quote is wrong, Hale, nothing more. You still haven't answered whether anyone asked Owen before the zero went in.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

I'm writing down Thursday, 8:15, your room, the vice-principal. The zero comes off the gradebook first, and I want "nothing goes on his record" in an email from you tonight. Who else will be in that room?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero removed from the gradebook and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect that email from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she took your offer of a supervised rewrite down in her notes but did not agree to it, and she still wants the zero off first, the no-record promise in writing, and to know who else would be in the room.
What moved her: you gave exact times from the version history and a wrongly attributed line she could check herself, which is the kind of dated, specific material she weighs.
What cost ground: you never answered whether Owen was spoken to before the zero went in, and she asked twice, so it stayed a hole in your process.
Try next time: when she asked you to turn the screen, show her the page right then, and answer the question about Owen before moving to the rewrite offer.
